title: Quests
subtitle: Everything you might do, waiting calmly until you pick it.

empty.backlog_body: Add a quest whenever something is on your mind. It will wait here until you are ready.
empty.inbox_body: Press + or Q anytime to catch a thought in one line. It lands here to sort later.
empty.done_body: Every step you check off counts. Your first finished quest will show up here.
empty.archived_body: Quests you set aside rest here. You can bring any of them back.
empty.filtered_body: Try fewer words or clear a filter.

inbox.hint: Turn a captured thought into a real quest, or send it straight to the backlog.

status.inbox: In your inbox, ready to sort

board.title: Active quests
board.empty_body: Add a new quest or choose one from your backlog. Small is perfect.

form.subtitle: Only the name is needed. Everything else can wait.
form.title: Quest name
form.title_placeholder: What do you want to get done?
form.title_needed: Give your quest a name first.
form.steps_hint: Optional. Tiny steps make starting easier.
form.quick_hint: Quick steps can be checked off without a timer.
form.difficulty_hint: Rank {{rank}} pays {{xp}} XP and {{gold}} gold in total.
form.guess_hint: Your best guess is fine. Comparing it later helps you plan.
form.activate_full: Your {{limit}} active spots are taken, so it will wait in the backlog.

first_step.hint: Starting is easiest with a first step under 5 minutes. This one is about {{minutes}}. Want to make it smaller?

estimate.suggestion: You usually take about {{ratio}}× your guess. Use {{minutes}} instead?

recurrence.hint: The next one appears when you finish this one. Missed days never pile up.

ai.plan_ready: Here is a plan. Rename, reorder or remove anything before you save.
ai.meta_note: Priority, difficulty and time were suggested for you. Change anything you like.

unavailable.unconfigured: AI helpers are not set up yet.
unavailable.limit_reached: AI helpers are resting until tomorrow.
unavailable.failed: That did not work this time.
unavailable.fallback: You can keep going on your own; everything else works.

no_timer.title: This one looks like it needs focus time
no_timer.note: Either answer is fine. You get the full reward when you say it is done.

detail.missing_body: It may have been deleted. Your other quests are safe.
detail.limit_note: You can have up to {{limit}} active quests at once.

boss.title: Boss quest
boss.offer_rank: An S-rank quest can become a boss: every step you finish damages it, and beating it pays {{bonus}} extra.
boss.offer_waiting: This quest has been waiting a while. Turn it into a boss? Every step damages it, and beating it pays {{bonus}} extra.
boss.became: A boss appears! Every step you finish will hit it.

swap.title: Your active list is full
swap.body: You have {{limit}} active quests. Pick one to rest in the backlog so “{{title}}” can take its place. Its progress stays.
swap.swap_for: Send “{{title}}” to the backlog and swap

capture.title: Quick capture
capture.body: One line is enough. It goes to your Inbox to sort later.
capture.label: What is on your mind?

overdue.title: Can this still be done?
overdue.body: “{{title}}” had a date that has passed.
overdue.note: Either way is fine. If it no longer fits, it can rest in the archive.

toast.saved_active: It is on your Today board.
toast.saved_backlog: It is waiting in your backlog.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Quests you do again and again, ready with their steps.
templates.empty_body: Open any quest and choose “Save as template” to reuse it.

categories.title: Categories and tags
categories.subtitle: Colors and icons that help you spot quests at a glance.
categories.heading: Categories
categories.delete_body: Its quests stay, just without a category.
categories.name: Name

tags.heading: Tags
tags.hint: Add tags from the quest form. Rename or remove them here.
tags.empty_body: Tags you add to quests will show up here.
tags.name: Tag name

settings.title: Quests
settings.active_limit_hint: A short list keeps today clear. Starting another one asks you to swap.
